items.statement: The exact E2K CPU model, compiler build, target triple, ABI, sysroot, board revision and hardware lab are operator-supplied facts.
items.feature: Elbrus qualification API with separate toolchain, ABI and hardware evidence gates
items.unknown_behavior: Do not guess compiler names, endianness, pointer width, CPU features or board support; target qualification stays pending.
verification: A complete target profile is required.
PASS and FAIL states must reference retained reports.
Qualification requires toolchain, ABI and target bring-up evidence.
Host tests are not represented as E2K tests.
